findings.claim: The allowlist omits `golden_traces/**` and `notebooks/**` which were explicitly required by the release plan.

No files needed at build time (e.g., `include_str!` targets, `build.rs` reads, `readme`/`license-file`) are dropped by the allowlist. `tests/**` inclusion is not a size/time problem because the 802 quarantined files were deleted (leaving ~5.6M uncompressed) and `cargo package` does not compile tests by default.

The tests do not pass vacuously on mutations. `cargo package --list` failures cause `output.status.success()` to panic in the Rust tests. In the plan's `A_1` command, while `grep -cE` passes vacuously on empty output from a failed cargo command, the subsequent `grep -qx Cargo.lock` catches the failure.

Deleted quarantine directories are not referenced by any Cargo.toml [[test]] entries, Makefiles, scripts, or workflows on main; only a comment in `tests/probar_wasm_qa.rs` mentions them, so no breakage occurs.
Renaming `signal` to `signal_val` does not change any printed output or shadow any existing variables.
The manifest is exactly complete; 155 `.ruchy` files parse successfully at HEAD and match the manifest.

The test does not skip silently when the binary is missing. `assert_cmd`'s `cargo_bin_cmd!` panics if the binary is missing, which `catch_unwind` catches, appending the failure to the `failures` array and failing the final assertion.
